input.prompt: Create one photorealistic16:9 WHAT IT COST documentary editorial frame, matching the supplied REAL VIDEO008 scene references in natural materials, camera scale and neutral soft window light. References are STYLE ONLY, never copy their Anthropic text or figures. Ordinary contemporary charcoal pebbled desktop, clean lightly handled ivory paper and simple stationery. NO rusty machines, counters, pedestals, giant floating headlines, brass stage props, dust beams, fantasy lighting, empty sheets, pseudo-writing or collage. Type belongs naturally on meaningful printed analytical paper, normal black serif report typography, NOT huge poster signs. These are our original documentary EDITORIAL ANALYSIS sheets, never authentic Fyre/DOJ/SEC/company records. The small page heading must say EDITORIAL ANALYSIS; no official seal, letterhead, signature, account number, fake quote or source facsimile. Print only requested verified text; no invented rows, values, monthly distribution or financial instrument. No red/yellow ink, highlights, borders, callouts, circles, underlines or motion. Simple normal black table rules are allowed. All meaningful text in upper75%, bottom20%free of important content for later separate Fusion layers. One continuous realistic shot, no overlaid banner. Only the requested subject props, no devices or UI, no money/coins/tickets unless explicitly requested. A plain printed documentary analysis of stock-holdings claims, NOT a reconstructed brokerage statement. One readable ivory comparison worksheet in a slim file, charcoal textured desktop, small normal calculator at the edge, no magnifying apparatus or industrial plaques. Exact page text: 'EDITORIAL ANALYSIS'; heading 'Stock Holdings — Claimed vs Actual'; table headings 'Measure | Value'; rows 'Claimed stock holdings | More than $2.5M', 'Actual stock holdings | Less than $1,500', 'Case source | SEC complaint'. Short note 'The comparison concerns share value, not cash balances or stolen shares.' Maintain both inequality bounds, no drawn proportional bar or exact balance. No account holder, account number, bank/company/SEC seal, signature or authentic-document impersonation. Natural normal-size black serif printing like VIDEO008, no red ink or banners.
